feedback: This game is too hard, can you make the cars run slower and make the game a tad more easier?

selection.reason: Car generation, including their speeds, and player starting stats like lives are typically initialized in resetGame. Modifying this function allows us to reduce car speeds and make the game easier.

patch.notes: Reduced the maximum and minimum speed of the cars, and decreased the maximum number of cars per lane to make the game easier as requested.
